title: Dragging the boundary between two panes resizes them
body:
Ratios in the split tree have no way to change.

## Proposal

A pointer press on the outline cells between two sibling panes finds the
split node whose boundary runs there; motion while pressed moves that
node's ratio so the boundary follows the pointer in whole cells; release
ends it. Clients are reconfigured as the boundary moves. No keyboard
equivalent, by decision.
close_reason: Done in the commit titled 'Lay panes out as a split tree with anchors and a Ctrl bar', 2026-11-06, with unit tests on the layout model for bar hit areas and boundary dragging. The bar, the drag and the palette need a hand on keyboard and mouse to check and are untested on screen as of this close; Jack is the tester.
